project_type: React + TypeScript frontend with Python FastAPI backend, fingerprint biometric system
build_system: npm + Vite for frontend, direct Python execution for backend
test_framework: No formal test framework discovered, manual testing required
test_command: manual testing with SecuGen hardware required
verification_instructions: 1) Check backend starts without errors, 2) Test /api/fingerprint/device-status endpoint returns proper response structure, 3) Test frontend UI shows only scanner interface without upload controls, 4) Verify scanner status updates properly in UI
snapshot_or_generated_files: frontend/dist/* build artifacts get created by npm run build
environment_constraints: SecuGen Bio Server on port 8000 or SecuGen Connect Bridge on ports 4494-4499 required for hardware testing. FastAPI backend runs on port 8000.
contribution_requirements: Preserve existing authentication.py identify_fingerprint() pipeline, maintain all existing recognition logic, keep backward compatibility
key_patterns: FastAPI endpoints use @app.get/@app.post decorators, React functional components with useState hooks, async/await for API calls, cn() helper for conditional CSS classes
directory_structure: Root contains Python backend files, frontend/ contains React TypeScript app, experiments/ for outputs, .agents/tasks/ for workflow artifacts
